6 تباعد : see 1, in six places. ―
-b2- [It also signifies He became alienated, or estranged, from his family or friends. ―
-b3- And تباعدوا They became distant, or remote, one from another; they went, removed, retired, or withdrew themselves, to a distance, far away, or far off, one from another; they removed themselves far, or kept aloof, one from another.] You say, كَانُوا مُتَقَارِبِينَ فَتَبَاعَدُوا [They were near, one to another, and they became distant, or remote, one from another]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
